name: Yash Management & Satellite Ltd.
about: Yash Management & Satellite Ltd. engages in wholesale trading activities in India. The company imports and exports agricultural products, such as food grains, pulses, and oil seeds, etc.; metals, including copper, iron, semi-precious metals, and precious metals; textile products; and other industrial products. Yash Management & Satellite Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.
